content: It will help to know what operating system you use and its version, such as Windows 7, Windows 10, Linux, etc. Also, is there a particular feature that is causing problems? The releases have been very similar since 2022 (version 102), but older versions are available also. Predictably, we would prefer to assist you in the current version, but will focus on whichever is your preference.
